G1201.def: from a derivative of «1199» (equivalent to «1196»); a place of bondage, i.e. a dungeon:--prison.

G1202.def: from the same as «1201»; (passively) a captive:--prisoner.

G1203.def: perhaps from «1210» and posis (a husband); an absolute ruler ("despot"):--Lord, master.

G1204.def: of uncertain affinity; here; used also imperative hither!; and of time, hitherto:--come (hither), hither(-to).

G1205.et: from (1204) and an imperative form of eimi (to go)
G1205.def: from «1204» and an imperative form of eimi (to go); come hither!:--come, × follow.

G1206.def: from «1208»; secondary, i.e. (specially) on the second day:--next day.

G1207.pos:
1. second-first
  2. the second of the first Sabbaths after the feast of the Passover
G1207.def: from «1208» and «4413»; second-first, i.e. (specially) a designation of the Sabbath immediately after the Paschal week (being the second after Passover day, and the first of the seven Sabbaths intervening before Pentecost):--second ... after the first.

G1208.def: as the compare of «1417»; (ordinal) second (in time, place, or rank; also adverb):--afterward, again, second(-arily, time).

G1209.et: middle voice of a primary verb
G1209.def: middle voice of a primary verb; to receive (in various applications, literally or figuratively):--accept, receive, take. Compare «2983».

G1210.def: a primary verb; to bind (in various applications, literally or figuratively):--bind, be in bonds, knit, tie, wind. See also «1163», «1189».

G1211.pos:
1. now, then, verily, in truth, really, surely, certainly
  2. forthwith, at once
G1211.def: probably akin to «1161»; a particle of emphasis or explicitness; now, then, etc.:--also, and, doubtless, now, therefore.

G1212.def: of uncertain derivation; clear:--+ bewray, certain, evident, manifest.

G1213.def: from «1212»; to make plain (by words):--declare, shew, signify.

G1215.def: from a compound of «1218» and «58»; to be a people-gatherer, i.e. to address a public assembly:--make an oration.

G1216.def: from Demeter (Ceres); Demetrius, the name of an Ephesian and of a Christian:--Demetrius.

G1217.def: from «1218» and «2041»; a worker for the people, i.e. mechanic (spoken of the Creator):--maker.

G1218.def: from «1210»; the public (as bound together socially):--people.

G1219.def: from «1218»; public; (feminine singular dative case as adverb) in public:--common, openly, publickly.

G1220.def: of Latin origin; a denarius (or ten asses):--pence, penny(-worth).

G1221.def: from «1211» and «4218»; a particle of generalization; indeed, at any time:--(what-)soever.

G1222.def: from «1211» and «4225»; a particle of asseveration; indeed doubtless:--verily.

G1223.et: a primary preposition denoting the channel of an act
G1223.def: a primary preposition denoting the channel of an act; through (in very wide applications, local, causal, or occasional):--after, always, among, at, to avoid, because of (that), briefly, by, for (cause) ... fore, from, in, by occasion of, of, by reason of, for sake, that, thereby, therefore, × though, through(-out), to, wherefore, with (-in). In composition it retains the same general importance.

G1224.def: from «1223» and the base of «939»; to cross:--come over, pass (through).

G1226.et: middle voice of a compound of (1223) and (950)
G1226.def: middle voice of a compound of «1223» and «950»; to confirm thoroughly (by words), i.e. asseverate:--affirm constantly.

G1227.def: from «1223» and «991»; to look through, i.e. recover full vision:--see clearly.

G1228.def: from «1225»; a traducer; specially, Satan (compare «07854»):--false accuser, devil, slanderer.

G1229.def: from «1223» and the base of «32»; to herald thoroughly:--declare, preach, signify.

G1230.def: from «1223» and «1096»; to elapse meanwhile:--X after, be past, be spent.

G1231.def: from «1223» and «1097»; to know thoroughly, i.e. ascertain exactly:--(would) enquire, know the uttermost.

G1232.def: from «1123» and «1107»; to tell abroad:--make known.

G1234.def: from «1223» and «1111»; to complain throughout a crowd:--murmur.

G1235.def: from «1223» and «1127»; to waken thoroughly:--be awake.

G1236.def: from «1223» and «71»; to pass time or life:--lead life, living.

G1237.def: from «1223» and «1209»; to receive in turn, i.e. (figuratively) succeed to:--come after.

G1238.def: from a compound of «1223» and «1210»; a "diadem" (as bound about the head):--crown. Compare «4735».

G1239.def: from «1223» and «1325»; to give throughout a crowd, i.e. deal out; also to deliver over (as to a successor):--(make) distribute(-ion), divide, give.

G1242.def: from «1303»; properly, a disposition, i.e. (specially) a contract (especially a devisory will):--covenant, testament.

G1243.def: from «1244»; a distinction or (concretely) variety:--difference, diversity.

G1244.def: from «1223» and «138»; to separate, i.e. distribute:--divide.

G1245.def: from «1223» and «2511»; to cleanse perfectly, i.e. (specially) winnow:--thoroughly purge.

G1246.et: middle voice from (1223) and a compound of (2596) and (1651)
G1246.def: middle voice from «1223» and a compound of «2596» and «1651»; to prove downright, i.e. confute:--convince.

G1247.def: from «1249»; to be an attendant, i.e. wait upon (menially or as a host, friend, or (figuratively) teacher); technically, to act as a Christian deacon:--(ad-)minister (unto), serve, use the office of a deacon.

G1248.def: from «1249»; attendance (as a servant, etc.); figuratively (eleemosynary) aid, (official) service (especially of the Christian teacher, or technically of the diaconate):--(ad-)minister(-ing, -tration, -try), office, relief, service(-ing).

G1249.et: probably from an obsolete diako (to run on errands, cf (1377))
G1249.def: probably from an obsolete diako (to run on errands; compare «1377»); an attendant, i.e. (genitive case) a waiter (at table or in other menial duties); specially, a Christian teacher and pastor (technically, a deacon or deaconess):--deacon, minister, servant.

G1251.def: middle voice from «1223» and «191»; to hear throughout, i.e. patiently listen (to a prisoner's plea):--hear.

G1252.def: from «1223» and «2919»; to separate thoroughly, i.e. (literally and reflexively) to withdraw from, or (by implication) oppose; figuratively, to discriminate (by implication, decide), or (reflexively) hesitate:--contend, make (to) differ(-ence), discern, doubt, judge, be partial, stagger, waver.

G1254.def: from «1223» and «2967»; to hinder altogether, i.e. utterly prohibit:--forbid.

G1255.def: from «1223» and «2980»; to talk throughout a company, i.e. converse or (genitive case) publish:--commune, noise abroad.

G1256.def: middle voice from «1223» and «3004»; to say thoroughly, i.e. discuss (in argument or exhortation):--dispute, preach (unto), reason (with), speak.

G1257.def: from «1223» and «3007»; to leave off in the middle, i.e. intermit:--cease.

G1258.def: from «1256»; a (mode of) discourse, i.e. "dialect":--language, tongue.

G1259.def: from «1223» and «236»; to change thoroughly, i.e. (mentally) to conciliate:--reconcile.

G1260.def: from «1223» and «3049»; to reckon thoroughly, i.e. (genitive case) to deliberate (by reflection or discussion):--cast in mind, consider, dispute, muse, reason, think.

G1261.def: from «1260»; discussion, i.e. (internal) consideration (by implication, purpose), or (external) debate:--dispute, doubtful(-ing), imagination, reasoning, thought.

G1263.def: from «1223» and «3140»; to attest or protest earnestly, or (by implication) hortatively:--charge, testify (unto), witness.

G1264.def: from «1223» and «3164»; to fight fiercely (in altercation):--strive.

G1265.def: from «1223» and «3306»; to stay constantly (in being or relation):--continue, remain.

G1266.def: from «1223» and «3307»; to partition thoroughly (literally in distribution, figuratively in dissension):--cloven, divide, part.

G1268.def: from «1223» and the base of «3551»; to distribute, i.e. (of information) to disseminate:--spread.

G1269.def: from «1223» and «3506»; to nod (or express by signs) across an intervening space:--beckon.

G1270.def: from a compound of «1223» and «3539»; something thought through, i.e. a sentiment:--thought.

G1271.def: from «1223» and «3563»; deep thought, properly, the faculty (mind or its disposition), by implication, its exercise:-- imagination, mind, understanding.

G1272.def: from «1223» and «455»; to open thoroughly, literally (as a first-born) or figuratively (to expound):--open.

G1273.def: from «1223» and a derivative of «3571»; to sit up the whole night:--continue all night.

G1274.def: from «1223» and anuo (to effect); to accomplish thoroughly:--finish.

G1275.def: from «1223» and the genitive case of «3956»; through all time, i.e. (adverbially) constantly:--alway(-s), continually.

G1276.et: from (1223) and a derivative of the base of (4008)
G1276.def: from «1223» and a derivative of the base of «4008»; to cross entirely:--go over, pass (over), sail over.

G1277.def: from «1223» and «4126»; to sail through:--sail over.

G1278.def: from «1223» and a derivative of «4192»; to toil through, i.e. (passively) be worried:--be grieved.

G1279.def: from «1223» and «4198»; to travel through:--go through, journey in, pass by.

G1280.def: from «1223» and «639»; to be thoroughly nonplussed:--(be in) doubt, be (much) perplexed.

G1281.def: from «1223» and «4231»; to thoroughly occupy oneself, i.e. (transitively and by implication) to earn in business:--gain by trading.

G1282.def: from «1223» and the base of «4249»; to saw asunder, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate:--cut (to the heart).

G1283.def: from «1223» and «726»; to seize asunder, i.e. plunder:--spoil.

G1284.def: from «1223» and «4486»; to tear asunder:--break, rend.

G1285.def: from «1223» and saphes (clear); to clear thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) declare:--tell unto.

G1286.def: from «1223» and «4579»; to shake thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to intimidate:--do violence to.

G1287.def: from «1223» and «4650»; to dissipate, i.e. (genitive case) to rout or separate; specially, to winnow; figuratively, to squander:--disperse, scatter (abroad), strew, waste.

G1288.def: from «1223» and «4685»; to draw apart, i.e. sever or dismember:--pluck asunder, pull in pieces.

G1289.def: from «1223» and «4687»; to sow throughout, i.e. (figuratively) distribute in foreign lands:--scatter abroad.

G1290.def: from «1289»; dispersion, i.e. (specially and concretely) the (converted) Israelite resident in Gentile countries:--(which are) scattered (abroad).

G1291.def: middle voice from «1223» and «4724»; to set (oneself) apart (figuratively, distinguish), i.e. (by implication) to enjoin:--charge, that which was (give) commanded(-ment).

G1294.def: from «1223» and «4762»; to distort, i.e. (figuratively) misinterpret, or (morally) corrupt:--perverse(-rt), turn away.

G1295.def: from «1223» and «4982»; to save thoroughly, i.e. (by implication or analogy) to cure, preserve, rescue, etc.:--bring safe, escape (safe), heal, make perfectly whole, save.

G1298.def: from «1223» and «5015»; to disturb wholly, i.e. agitate (with alarm):--trouble.

G1299.def: from «1223» and «5021»; to arrange thoroughly, i.e. (specially) institute, prescribe, etc.:--appoint, command, give, (set in) order, ordain.
